slides.say: Nintendo is one hundred and thirty seven years old. For most of that time, it never made a video game.
It began in eighteen eighty-nine in Kyoto. Fusajiro Yamauchi made hanafuda, Japanese playing cards.
In the sixties, Hiroshi Yamauchi tried everything. A taxi company. Instant rice. All failed. Then came toys.
Engineer Gunpei Yokoi built the Ultra Hand toy. In nineteen eighty, his Game and Watch put games in your pocket.
A year later, Donkey Kong gave us Mario. And Nintendo still makes playing cards. Follow for more brand stories.

facts.founded: Nintendo founded 23 Sep 1889 in Kyoto by Fusajiro Yamauchi to make hanafuda (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Nintendo) — 137 years old on 2026-10-23
facts.no_games: first video game products 1975-77 (EVR Race, Color TV-Game): 1889-1977 = 88 of 137 years
facts.ventures: Daiya Taxi 1960; food company with instant rice; "All of Nintendo's other business ventures eventually failed" (History of Nintendo). Love hotels left out: disputed (no evidence in 1962 securities reports)
facts.ultra_hand: Ultra Hand 1966, built by Gunpei Yokoi (History of Nintendo; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gunpei_Yokoi)
facts.donkey_kong: Donkey Kong, arcades 1981, origin of Mario (History of Nintendo)
facts.cards_today: nintendo.com/jp/others/hanafuda_kabufuda lists Mario hanafuda, Daitouryou, Fukutengu, Miyako no Hana (checked 2026-10-23)
